raw_recipe.headline: Lemon Pie II
raw_recipe.description: This simple no-bake pie is made with cream cheese, sweetened condensed milk, and lemon juice in a graham cracker crust. Dress it up with a fruit glaze, or serve it with whipped cream.

video.description: This simple pie recipe in this video can be served as is in a graham crust or you can dress it up with a strawberry or peach glaze. Either way, a little Cool Whip or whipped cream on top is good.

review.reviewBody: Very easy recipe. Make sure that the cream cheese if fully softened before mixing the ingredients. I added more lemon juice, because it just didn't taste like lemon pie. My family loves it. I have made it 3 times already.

I read quite a few reviews stating to make sure your cream cheese is at room temp. And to use a 1/2 cup lemon juice. I think this is important to note ...If you are using a metal bowl such as a kitchen aid mixer the bowl acts as a refrigerator and your cream cheese will get cold again. You will want your cream cheese a bit warmer...microwave it for 30 seconds in a small bowl and mix it with a spoon, you want it softer than the cream cheese spread containers that you use for bagels. You may need another 15 seconds (depending on your microwave) I used 2 Meyer Lemons which equals 1/2 cup lemon juice. I zested first then cut lemons in half and juiced then strained to remove all the seeds. ( Meyer Lemons have a lot of seeds) they have a mellow sweet flavor versus sour and worked super in this recipe. Also added 1 Tsp. Vanilla extract. Topped with raspberries. Absolutely delicious! review.reviewBody:
I loved this recipe but made my own 2 layer version using Jello Instant Lemon Pudding. 
 I - 3oz box of Lemon instant Pudding
1 cup of milk
- Mix pudding and instant milk with a whisk or hand blender for about 1 minute until its thickened 
- Add 110g (half) of room temperature or whipped regular sizes pkg of cream cheese
Whisk or beat into pudding mix until smooth. 
- Fold in 1 cup (8oz / 250 ml) of stabilized whipped cream or cool whip 
- Add it into a premise 9” Graham Cracker Pie crust. 
- Top that mixture with stabilized whip cream or cool whip and chill for at least 4 hours. Preferably overnight. 
I take about 4-6 days to enjoy it so I freeze it for 2 hours, remove and cut it into the amount of slices I want from the pie and place it back in the freezer. About 2 hours before I want a slice or 2 I take them out of the freezer and thaw them in the fridge or if I need them quickly about 1 hour at room temp. 
Absolutely deeeelish. I call it …
Lemon Cream Cheese Dream Pie.

Tweaks: I used baked standard pastry crust ,cooled, zested 1 large lemon and 2 standard limes. Sprinkled that zest all over bottom of baked shell. Used fresh lemon and lime juice at a full 1/2 C. total. Added 1 t. lemon extract and 1 t. vanilla bean paste. Also, since I used lemon and lime, I added 2 tiny drops of green food color-really elevated the look. Topped with real whipped cream made w heavy whipping cream, about 1 C., added 3 T. powdered sugar and a tiny dollop of vanilla bean paste to taste. Delicious!

I made this for a family BBQ. Instead of a single pie, i doubled the recipe, made a batch of crust and filled 23 foil lined muffins with batter. I also used more lemon juice for a tart flavor. Everyone loved them! Next time I will garnish with some lemon peel as well.

Great recipe and like many here I up the lemon juice to 1/2 cup (3 lemons) but first I zested the 3 lemons and sprinkled the zest on the crust before adding the filling, this way the zest stays moist and doesn't dry out on top. I also macerated a cup of raspberries and added a couple of tablespoons of simple syrup to the berries (this I served on the side), everyone liked it.

TRY THIS FROZEN. you will not regret it! Family staple since childhood but the author is missing the best part. You have to freeze it overnight! You set it out for approx 30 minutes just to cut, similar to an ice cream cake. So refreshing!! If you like the lemon taste use fresh lemon juice- it will make a huge difference. You can also top with cherry pie filling (or any filling goes well) but then you CANNOT refreeze. So if you will not be serving the whole pie I wouldn’t recommend.

I've made this pie probably six times now, and each time it's a hit! It's light and delicious. Like many others suggested, I doubled the lemon to make it a little more lemony. I also put cool whip in a piping bag, and piped rosettes on it before I served it.

This pie is great! Quick and easy :o) I did use 1/2 cup of fresh lemon juice plus a T. of lemon zest. and a tsp. of vanilla in the filling. If you have the time to make your own crust, Do It! (1.5 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1/2 cup sugar and 5 T. melted butter. Bake at 350 for 7 - 10 minutes) Also, If you have even more extra time and extra money, make your own whipped topping too! Directions: Place one cup heavy whipping cream and 3 T. confectioner's sugar in a chilled mixing bowl, beat until stiff peaks form. Spread on top of this delicious pie and enjoy!!

This is a pie my mother has been making since I was a little girl. We call it a cream cheese pie. She adds 1tsp of vanilla extract and may use up to 1/2 c of lemon juice. It is a staple at family functions, and is always yummy. Mom always says it is very important to have the cream cheese at room temp, and beat it first separate from the other ingredients so you have a homgeneous mixture:-)

Ok folks . We try to review as written , and I will. But then I made again with a few modifications which made it over the top delicious. It was just good as written but the second time around I added frozen lemon aid concentrate approx 1/4 c to the lemon juice and a heaping tbsp of lemon zest. Be sure to beat room temperature cream till smooth before adding concentrate . I froze for four hours to be sure all set up and served with real heavy whipping cream beaten with powder sugar and vanilla . Was a 5 plus star summer dessert! Also forget those prepared graham cracker pie shells. Do yourself a favor and make your own simple easy and recipes on this site take meat minutes to make!

Super easy. I made for church pot-luck and it was a hit with none left over. I added about 1 teaspoon lemon extract to boost lemo flavor and added a few drops yellow food coloring to enhance color. As always when using cream cheese allow it to soften before mixing. I used a store bought Graham Cracker crust and forgot to get any toppings and no one seemed to miss the topping.
I am all about bang-for-your-buck (read: time) recipes. This is simple with just a few ingredients and still packs a yum-punch! Everyone raves about this pie!

It was easy and came out well even in the hot and humid weather here in Southern Mexico. I added a couple of drops of lemon extract and vanilla. I also had a bag of frozen mixed berries in my freezer, so I defrosted and drained some and added them to the mix at the end. It was a fun and easy recipe that you could tweek in 100 ways.
Loved it! I did do a strawberry glaze!

I made my own crust, which did give it a lot more flavor. I used a couple of extra Tbs. of lemon juice because that's what was left. I also added the zest of 1 lemon but looking back, I would have used it from both. I agree that the cream cheese needs to be very soft. I took mine out several hours before preparation. I used a hand-mixer and everything came together easily. I'd make this again, but to bump up the lemon flavor, maybe I'd add a bit of lemon extract or even lemon curd.
I followed the recipe using fresh squeezed lemon juice and garnishing the top with lemon zest.

This was just ok. However, I substituted Nuefchatel cheese as it is 1/3 less fat than cream cheese and I squeezed 2.5 fresh lemons to add almost 1/2 cup of lemon juice. The Nuefchatel required more than 25 minutes of mixing in the KitchenAid in order to smooth out the lumps. It was ok, nothing fantastic, it was edible, but never really achieved anything near "wow" or "delicious." I won't be making it again.
I did sugar free whipping cream and 1/3 less fat cream cheese. Still a crowd pleaser! The only time consuming part was the fresh squeeze lemon juice.
Very easy to make had all ingredients didn't have to go out
